package.name: cite_runtime
package.description:
Process lifecycle for this repository's Python nodes: start rclpy, spin until the context is shut down, release it. Nothing else.
ADMISSION TEST, and it is the whole reason this package exists rather than a module inside a node package. Something belongs here only if all three hold:
1. it is process lifecycle MECHANISM — start-up, shutdown, signals; 2. it carries NO DOMAIN KNOWLEDGE — no facility, no asset, no topic, no layer of the L0-L7 stack is nameable from inside it; 3. it DEPENDS ON NOTHING IN-PROJECT — rclpy and the standard library only, so that every other package may depend on it without direction.
Anything that fails one of those belongs in the package that owns the behaviour. Test dependencies obey the rule too: the tests here drive a probe node this package owns, never another package's node, because a test edge is still an edge and would make rule 3 false.
ADR-0034 records the decision and what was weighed against it.
